name: Guadalajara (Spain)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Guadalajara (a knight in armour before the walls of the city on a starry night sky).
history: The flag of Guadalajara is a purple cloth, a colour widespread among Castilian municipal flags, of 2:3, charged at the centre with the arms of the city, which depict the night scene of an armoured knight and soldiers before the walls of the city, an allusion to the legendary capture of Guadalajara by Álvar Fáñez on the night of Saint John in 1085.
